sys_remote_update_set.description:
Description: This implementation focuses on enhancing the Issue Management application by improving access controls, adding new business rules, and optimizing user interface elements.
Done What: - Created or updated multiple Access Controls for the Issue Management application, including: - Access Controls for issues, tasks, and management data lookups. - Developed several Business Rules such as: - "Issue - State In Progress When Assigned" - "Issue - Capture Last Journal Update" - "Issue - VIP caller has p1" - "Issue - Problem when issue Resolved" - Added new Application Menus and Modules for better navigation. - Implemented various UI Policies to enforce field requirements based on issue states. - Enhanced the user interface with new Form Layouts and List Layouts. - Established new Flows for notifications related to issue assignments and state changes.
How useful to users: These enhancements streamline the issue management process, ensuring that users have the right access, receive timely notifications, and can easily navigate through the application. This leads to improved efficiency and better handling of issues.
Assigned: 2026-07-17 03:23:16
Completed: 2026-10-06 22:48:08
Updateset: https://dev317755.service-now.com/sys_update_set.do?sys_id=8f9e200bc38e0b10fc78fb377d013163

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2162532_issue_0_issue</collection><condition>!current.date.nil()</condition><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Issue - Extract Day and Add to Current D</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    if (current.date.nil()) {
        return;
    }

    var inputDate = new GlideDateTime(current.date);

    // Get date part in system format yyyy-MM-dd
    var dateOnly = inputDate.getDate().getByFormat('yyyy-MM-dd');

    // Split yyyy-MM-dd and get dd
    var parts = dateOnly.split('-');
    var day = parseInt(parts[2], 10);

    var currentDate = new GlideDateTime();
    currentDate.addDaysLocalTime(day);

    gs.addInfoMessage('Extracted day is ' + day + '. New date after adding days is ' + currentDate.getDisplayValue());

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-05 09:19:13</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>05c0da4dc3a2cbd0fc78fb377d01316a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Issue - Extract Day and Add to Current D</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Issue Management" source="x_2162532_issue_0">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Issue Management">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_05c0da4dc3a2cbd0fc78fb377d01316a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-05 09:19:13</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=05c0da4dc3a2cbd0fc78fb377d01316a"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2162532_issue_0_issue_task</collection><condition>!current.issues.nil()</condition><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Issue - Update Issue on update in task</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    var currTaskNum = current.getValue('number');

    if (!current.issues.nil()) {

        var parent = current.issues.getRefRecord();

        if (parent.isValidRecord()) {

            var gdt = new GlideDateTime();

            parent.work_notes = currTaskNum + ' is updated at ' + gdt.getDisplayValue();

            parent.setWorkflow(false);
            parent.update();
        }
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-05 12:38:31</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>8073cb85c36acbd0fc78fb377d0131cc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Issue - Update Issue on update in task</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Issue Management" source="x_2162532_issue_0">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Issue Management">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_8073cb85c36acbd0fc78fb377d0131cc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-05 12:46:29</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=8073cb85c36acbd0fc78fb377d0131cc"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2162532_issue_0_issue</collection><condition>current.state.changesTo('6') || current.state.changesTo('3')</condition><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Issue - No Issue close until task resolv</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    // Run only when Issue is being resolved or closed
    if (!(current.state.changesTo('6') || current.state.changesTo('3'))) {
        return;
    }

    // gs.info('issue = ' + current.getUniqueValue());

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_2162532_issue_0_issue_task');
    gr.addQuery('issues', current.getUniqueValue());
    gr.addQuery('state', 'NOT IN', '3,6');
    gr.setLimit(1);
    gr.query();

    if (gr.hasNext()) {
        gs.addErrorMessage('All issue taks should be closed before resolving/closing issue ' + current.getValue('number') + ' record');
        current.setAbortAction(true);
    }
	else{
		 gs.addInfoMessage('All issue taks resolved of ' + current.getValue('number') + ' record');
	}

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-05 11:40:43</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>1c323a81c3e6cbd0fc78fb377d013157</sys_id><sys_mod_count>11</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Issue - No Issue close until task resolv</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Issue Management" source="x_2162532_issue_0">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Issue Management">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_1c323a81c3e6cbd0fc78fb377d013157</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-05 12:16:20</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=1c323a81c3e6cbd0fc78fb377d013157"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2162532_issue_0_issue</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Issue - VIP caller has p1</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    if (current.caller_id.nil()) {
        return;
    }

    var caller = current.caller_id.getRefRecord();

    if (!caller.isValidRecord()) {
        return;
    }

    var vipValue = caller.getValue('vip');


    if (vipValue == '1' || vipValue == 'true') {


        current.setValue('impact', '1');
        current.setValue('urgency', '1');
        current.setValue('priority', '1');

	}

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-03 06:24:18</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>ca3adbd0c3aa47d0fc78fb377d0131d6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Issue - VIP caller has p1</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Issue Management" source="x_2162532_issue_0">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Issue Management">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_ca3adbd0c3aa47d0fc78fb377d0131d6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-03 07:19:47</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=ca3adbd0c3aa47d0fc78fb377d0131d6"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2162532_issue_0_issue</collection><condition>current.priority == '1' && current.state.changesTo('6')</condition><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Issue - Problem when issue Resolved</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    var gr = new GlideRecord('problem');
    gr.initialize();

    var newsd = 'This problem is created due to ' + current.getDisplayValue('number') + ' issue was P1 and got resolved';

    gr.short_description = newsd;
    gr.assigned_to = current.getValue('assigned_to');

    var sysId = gr.insert();

    gs.addInfoMessage(gr.getValue('number') + ' Problem Created for this Issue');

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-05 11:20:13</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>1f6d6e09c3a6cbd0fc78fb377d013143</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Issue - Problem when issue Resolved</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Issue Management" source="x_2162532_issue_0">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Issue Management">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_1f6d6e09c3a6cbd0fc78fb377d013143</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-05 11:20:13</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=1f6d6e09c3a6cbd0fc78fb377d013143"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2162532_issue_0_issue</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Issue - Problem created from Issue</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

	var required = current.getDisplayValue('problem_required');
	// gs.info('====================================');
	// gs.info('required  = '+ required);

	if(required == 'Yes'){
		var ga = new GlideRecord('problem');
		ga.initialize();

		var fields = ['short_description', 'impact', 'urgency', 'priority', 'category', 'subcategory','assigned_to'];

		for(var i=0;i<fields.length;i++){
			ga.setValue(fields[i], current.getValue(fields[i]));
		}

		// gs.info('inserted');
		
		var problemSysId = ga.insert();
		var problemNumber = ga.getValue('number');

		// gs.info(problemNumber);
		current.setValue('problem', problemSysId);
		current.update();

		// gs.addInfoMessage('Problem created: ' + ga.getValue('number') + ' for Issue: ' + current.getDisplayValue());
		// gs.info('Problem created: ' + ga.getValue('number') + ' for Issue: ' + current.getDisplayValue());
	}

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-05 05:41:05</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>d5146501c36e8bd0fc78fb377d013188</sys_id><sys_mod_count>9</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Issue - Problem created from Issue</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Issue Management" source="x_2162532_issue_0">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Issue Management">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_d5146501c36e8bd0fc78fb377d013188</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-05 06:20:47</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=d5146501c36e8bd0fc78fb377d013188"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2162532_issue_0_issue</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Issue - Date in between Start and End</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    if (current.start.nil() || 
        current.end.nil() || 
        current.date.nil()) {
        return;
    }

    var start = new GlideDateTime(current.start);
    var end = new GlideDateTime(current.end);
    var check = new GlideDateTime(current.date);

    if (start.after(end)) {
        gs.addErrorMessage('Start date/time cannot be after End date/time.');
        current.setAbortAction(true);
        return;
    }

    if (check.before(start) || check.after(end)) {
        gs.addErrorMessage('Check date/time must be between Start date/time and End date/time.');
        current.setAbortAction(true);
        return;
    }

    gs.addInfoMessage('Check date/time is between Start date/time and End date/time.');

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-05 08:06:44</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>7264b981c3ee8bd0fc78fb377d0131ea</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Issue - Date in between Start and End</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Issue Management" source="x_2162532_issue_0">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Issue Management">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_7264b981c3ee8bd0fc78fb377d0131ea</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-05 08:37:59</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=7264b981c3ee8bd0fc78fb377d0131ea"/></record_update>

    if (!current.contract_end_date.nil()) {

        var today = new GlideDateTime();

        var endDateValue = current.getValue('contract_end_date') + ' 23:59:59';
        var endDate = new GlideDateTime(endDateValue);

        if (endDate.before(today)) {
            gs.addInfoMessage('Contract of this caller is expired');
        }
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-02 06:38:27</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>eab39e4cc322c3d0fc78fb377d013109</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Issue - Contract Expired Message</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Issue Management" source="x_2162532_issue_0">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Issue Management">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_eab39e4cc322c3d0fc78fb377d013109</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-02 06:48:19</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=eab39e4cc322c3d0fc78fb377d013109"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>true</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2162532_issue_0_issue</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Issue - Update Child Count</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    var issueTable = 'x_2162532_issue_0_issue';

    // If child is inserted or updated with a parent
    if (current.getValue('parent_issues')) {
        updateParentChildCount(current.getValue('parent_issues'));
    }

    // If parent was changed, update the old parent count also
    if (previous && previous.getValue('parent_issues') && previous.getValue('parent_issues') != current.getValue('parent_issues')) {
        updateParentChildCount(previous.getValue('parent_issues'));
    }

    function updateParentChildCount(parentSysId) {

        var ga = new GlideAggregate(issueTable);
        ga.addQuery('parent_issues', parentSysId);
        ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
        ga.query();

        var count = 0;

        if (ga.next()) {
            count = ga.getAggregate('COUNT');
        }

        var parentGR = new GlideRecord(issueTable);

        if (parentGR.get(parentSysId)) {
            parentGR.setValue('child_issues', count);
            parentGR.setWorkflow(false);
            parentGR.update();
        }
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-05 10:55:11</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>930e1289c326cbd0fc78fb377d0131be</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Issue - Update Child Count</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Issue Management" source="x_2162532_issue_0">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Issue Management">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_930e1289c326cbd0fc78fb377d0131be</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-05 10:55:11</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=930e1289c326cbd0fc78fb377d0131be"/></record_update>

    // Check if field exists on company table

    current.setValue('issue_type', company.getValue('x_2162532_issue_0_type'));

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-03 05:07:48</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>a6888b9cc3e647d0fc78fb377d01312b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Issue - Populate Issues Type from Compan</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Issue Management" source="x_2162532_issue_0">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Issue Management">273de847c38e0b10fc78fb377d013161</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_a6888b9cc3e647d0fc78fb377d01312b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-03 05:59:50</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=a6888b9cc3e647d0fc78fb377d01312b"/></record_update>
